paper_title: Constraints on bosonic dark matter from ultralow-field nuclear magnetic resonance
coupling_convention: canonical g_aNN, dimensionless (plotted as g_aNN in GeV^-1 on axis label but treated as dimensionless per plot)
notes: CASPEr-ZULF ultralow-field NMR search on 13C-formic acid. Primary result is the ALP wind linear coupling g_aNN (assuming g_app=g_ann=g_aNN) in GeV^-1, shown in Fig.3 over mass range 1.86e-16 to 7.85e-14 eV. Values are approximate read-offs from the log-scale exclusion plot; sensitivity degrades ~1/omega toward higher masses. The coupling is technically a combined nucleon coupling (proton+neutron assumed equal), mapped here to AxionNeutron. Note the reported g_aNN is in GeV^-1 (unusual for a dimensionless spin coupling; this is the paper's convention using effective field D).
